description: MODIFIES THE FILESYSTEM. Switch the baked-in Cronus UI theme preset (and optionally the color mode) by running the version-pinned `cronus-ui theme set` CLI at the detected project root. Use this for aurora / neutral / midnight / sunset / emerald. For Create Studio permalinks or exported JSON, use `apply_theme` instead.

mode.description: Color mode to pin ('dark' or 'light'). Omitting leaves the current mode.

name: set_theme
title: Set the Cronus UI theme preset
